A maintainer merges the stack on GitHub: on the top PR's page (#3), the merge button merges that PR and every PR below it. Merging a lower PR lands only part of the stack. From a terminal, `gh pr merge` refuses a stacked PR; use merge-async on the top PR: `gh api -X PUT repos/acme/widget/pulls/3/merge-async -f merge_method=merge`. Then sync closes the merged features and moves any branch above onto main.
